page: Google Cloud Platform c4-highmem-32-lssd is a memory-optimized server instance powered by an Intel Xeon 6985P-C processor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading, operating at a base frequency of 2.3 GHz. The architecture is x86_64, supported by a 504 MB L3 cache. The instance is equipped with 248 GB of RAM, providing approximately 7.75 GB of memory per core. Local storage is bundled, consisting of 1745 GB of NVMe SSD capacity distributed across five local drives. No GPUs are included in this configuration.

Benchmark results indicate strong capabilities across multiple domains. The system achieves a Geekbench single-core score of 2307.0 and a multi-core score of 18257.0. Single-threaded gzip compression reaches 36.83 GB/sec, and single-threaded bzip3 decompression performs at 15.57 GB/sec, both placing in the top tier of tested servers. Memory performance is robust, with a Passmark memory score of 2796.01 and uncached read-only large block bandwidth of 168.46 GB/sec. The processor's Advanced Matrix Extensions and AVX-512 support contribute to strong LLM inference speeds, particularly for small models where text generation reaches 362.23 tokens/sec.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the c4-highmem-32-lssd offers high resource density by combining substantial memory capacity with fast, bundled local NVMe storage. This configuration mitigates the need for external storage attachments for high-throughput operations, optimizing the performance-per-resource ratio. This server is well-suited for memory-intensive and storage-heavy workloads, including database operations, caching layers such as Redis, data processing pipelines, and local software compilation.
